$description: score-king HIGH-CONTRAST semantic palette — a light-based mode that maximizes contrast for low vision / prefers-contrast: more. Restructured into the shared studio --semantic-* taxonomy. Emitted under [data-theme="high-contrast"]. Brand hues drop to their 700–900 steps for AA/AAA text contrast on white; borders and text go near-black. Chart series swap to the CVD-safe high-contrast variants in the generated index.css.

elevated.$description: White elevated surface with heavy border for definition.

secondary.$description: Still near-black — muted by role, not by low contrast.

inverse.$description: White text on dark interactive surfaces.

default.$description: Deep Royal Violet — clears AA/AAA text contrast on white.

positive.$description: Pair with icon+text — never color alone.

warning.$description: Uses 800, not 700. The high-contrast theme still renders on a haze background-raised surface, where amber at 700 measures only 4.37:1 — below AA in the one theme that must never fail. 800 measures 8.89:1 on white and 7.25:1 on haze.

info.$description: Uses 800, not 700, for the same reason as warning: sky at 700 measures 4.28:1 on the haze raised surface. 800 measures 8.05:1 on white and 6.57:1 on haze.

pending.$description: In-flight, processing, syncing. Pair with an icon or label; never signal state by hue alone.
